thread:
karen: Poking on a batching approach for auth checks at the edge. Main tradeoffs: fewer auth RPS vs keeping per-request billing & audit fidelity. Thoughts?

devin: We should preserve per-request attribution even if we send one auth call. Edge can tag each subrequest with a tiny tuple: (sub_id, org, project, sa, token_hash). Send compact array to the auth service and expect an ordered list of allow/deny + cost estimate.

ryan: Two operational constraints: 1) billing pipeline expects one event per request; 2) retries from proxy can cause double-counting. Suggest pattern: edge emits a single compressed telemetry envelope but include per-item idempotency keys so the downstream expansion emits N events idempotently.

karen: Agreed. UX: console shows per-route token breakdown. If we expand in the pipeline, console should show folded totals with an "expand batch" action that queries the expanded events by trace_id.

devin: Schema sketch (compact):
```
{trace_id, envelope_id, items:[{sub_id, org, proj, sa, tok_hash, req_id, idempotency_key}], checksum}
```
Auth service returns decisions in same item order. Edge then writes envelope header with X-RW-Trace and X-RW-Decision-IDs list.

policy-bot: (automated) Reminder: raw tokens are PII; only hashed tokens allowed in logs/audit. See internal policy.

ryan: Quotas: auth service should calculate per-item quota usage and emit per-item quota events (or return the usage so billing can accept it). Key: include an explicit 'usage_id' so billing can dedupe. We'll use idempotency_key = sha256(token_hash + req_id + minute_bucket).

devin: Rollout: start with 1% of traffic folded at the edge and mirror expanded events to current billing pipeline for comparison. Monitor metrics: billing_delta_percent and expand_fail_rate. Auto-fallback to per-request authz if billing_delta_percent > 0.2% for 15m.

karen: Oncall runbook: check billing_delta_percent dashboard, check envelope expansion failures, search for duplicate usage_ids. Revert by toggling edge flag to per-request mode.

ryan: Implementation note: compressed envelope should be base64 gzipped protobuf or ndjson; keep size under ~16KB per envelope. If item count hits N_limit (e.g., 50) fall back to per-request calls.

karen: OK I'll put a draft PR with the envelope proto and console drilldown mockup. Devin/Ryan please add idempotency & billing tests. Ping #eng-platform when draft ready. :thumbsup:
